title: Two-bedroom apartment
titleCn: 多伦多两居室公寓租房咨询

paragraphs.text: Apartments. Mary speaking. How may I help you?
Yes. I'm calling about the two-bedroom apartment advertised in the Toronto Star.
Okay. Well, I'm the owner of the apartment building.
Is the apartment still available starting in August?
There's been a slight change, and it's now available in June.
Good. Can you give me some details? I think the ad said the rent was 1100 dollars a month. Is that right?
Maybe you were looking at the ad for the one bedroom. The one bedroom apartment is 1100, but this one is 1300.
Oh, I see. And what kind of floors does it have?
Well, it used to be carpeted, but we just put in wood ones.
Right. And could you tell me what appliances there are?
There's a fridge that was new last year and a stove, which is a couple of years old.
So you mean there's no dishwasher?
No, I'm afraid not. Although the kitchen is reasonably big, there isn't enough space for one.
Oh. And what about the laundry facilities?
We have a laundry room which is shared by all the apartments in the building. It has brand-new laundry machines that don't require coins to operate.
Okay. So how do people use them?
All the tenants are given a card that they can use for the washers and dryers. It means you don't have to carry any money.
That's a good idea. I also wanted to ask if the apartment has a balcony.
Oh, yes. It faces west, and it's quite a nice size.
That's great because I really love to cook out on the balcony in summer.
Okay, but I should let you know that because of the fire regulations, a barbecue isn't permitted. But other types of cooker are fine if they're electric.
Oh. That's okay.
And I've got another question. Is there a locker that comes with the apartment? I'd like to put my bike in one.
We don't have any lockers available right now. However, we do have racks for tenants right outside the building.
I guess that would be okay then.
Before you hear the rest of the conversation, you have some time to look at questions six to ten.
Now listen and answer questions six to ten.
So what facilities or services does the apartment building have?
Well, one of the important things is that we have security twenty-four seven.
Great. Oh, another thing I wanted to ask was if you have exercise facilities.
Yes, we do. And our Aquafit classes in our pool are very popular. There's no charge for tenants.

Okay, that's good because I like to swim, you know. Well, this seems like a really nice apartment. When could I come down and have a look at it? I work during the day, so an evening appointment works best for me.
No problem.
How about Monday at 7:00?
Ugh, sorry. I'm afraid that time won't work as I'll be coming from downtown. How about 7:40?
Yeah, sure. That would be fine. In fact, it suits me better. Okay. So my name's Jim Cook.
Right.
And I just need to confirm the location with you.
We're at 236 Kerridge Road.
How do you spell the road name?
K-E-R-R-I-D-G-E.
Oh, okay. I'll be coming by subway from downtown. How do I get there?
Okay, let's see.
You'll take the northbound line and go five stops.
Right.
Then you transfer to the bus and go west for three stops until you see the library at the main intersection there.
Uh-huh.
Then when you've got off, you just walk north for about five or ten minutes.
Okay.
Then you'll see a park. We're just opposite that.
Great. I got it.
Right. I'll see you Monday evening, Jim. Take care.
